verdict_reason: Commodity-line migration is correct, but the spec keeps an inline copy of the add-a-line steps the PR promoted to the journey flow and keeps four comments narrating UI behaviour.

todos.issue: The PR deleted most narrating comments in this spec but kept four that narrate UI behaviour the assertions already state: lines 38-39 ('the in-card button finishes the line...'), 50-53 ('Count-drop guard... the records are never silently trimmed'), 69 ('Remove frees a slot...') and 76 ('With one record left the drop no longer applies...'). House rules: a comment never describes the UI; rationale goes in docs or the behaviour spec.
todos.fix: Must: the spec carries no comments narrating page behaviour; the test title and assertions state it. One way: delete the four comments; if a step needs naming, use test.step('count drop below the record count is blocked', ...) instead.

todos.issue: Lines 14-22 walk 'What are you importing?' -> searchAndCheckSpecies -> save -> 'Commodity details' -> count -> save inline. This PR promoted the same sequence to AnimalsJourney.addCommodityLine (flows/animals/journey.ts) but hardcoded a count of 1, so this spec (count 2) and animal-identifiers-conditional.spec.ts (three copies) keep local copies of it. Guide: a sequence used by two specs becomes a journey method and the local copies are deleted in the same change.
todos.fix: Must: one journey-flow method adds commodity lines with a given animal count, and this spec reaches its identification task through it with no inline copy of the steps. One way: give addCommodityLine an options object ({ animalCount }) or a variant taking several lines, and call it here with animalCount: 2.
